articles.title: AI与创造力
articles.subtitle: 为什么个人作品变好 集体作品却可能更相似
articles.sourceTitle: Generative AI enhances individual creativity but reduces the collective diversity of novel content
articles.editorialNote: 节选自论文引言与讨论部分，并非连续完整文章；保留英文措辞，删除段末参考文献编号。中文译文和句法标注为本材料新增。
articles.readingHint: 前3段提出两条可能机制，后2段限定研究结论。would expect表示预期；不要把假设直接当作已证明的结果。

paragraphs.en: There are at least two ways in which the availability of generative AI can affect creative writing in this context. On the one hand, generative AI may enhance: Generated ideas from AI may be used as a “springboard” for the human mind, providing potential starting points that can result in a “tree structure” of different storylines. It can also offer multiple starting venues that help a human writer overcome “writer’s block” and the fear of a blank page.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一情境中，能够使用生成式AI至少可以通过两种途径影响创意写作。一方面，生成式AI可能起到促进作用：AI生成的点子可以成为人类思维的“跳板”，提供潜在的起点，由此发展出像树一样分叉的不同故事线。它还可以提供多种入手方式，帮助作者克服“写作障碍”和面对空白纸页时的恐惧。

paragraphs.en: If this is the case, we would expect generative AI to lead to more creative written output generated by human writers. Conversely, generative AI may hamper: By anchoring the writer to a specific idea, or starting point for a story, generative AI may restrict the variability of a writer’s own ideas from the start, inhibiting the extent of creative writing. Moreover, the output offered by generative AI may be derivative and thus not provide a fertile ground for new and creative ideas.
paragraphs.zh: 如果情况如此，我们会预期生成式AI使人类作者写出更有创造力的作品。反过来，生成式AI也可能产生阻碍：它把作者固定在某个特定点子或故事起点上，可能从一开始就限制作者自身想法的多样性，进而限制创意写作的发挥。此外，生成式AI提供的内容可能只是对已有内容的衍生，因此无法为新颖、有创造力的想法提供肥沃土壤。

paragraphs.en: If this is the case, we would expect generative AI to lead to more similar stories and potentially less creative written output generated by human writers. Note that these two pathways in which generative AI can affect creative writing may not be mutually exclusive: It is possible that generative AI enhances a human’s ability to write creative stories in some ways (e.g., novelty) but not in others (e.g., usefulness).
paragraphs.zh: 如果是这种情况，我们会预期生成式AI使故事彼此更加相似，并可能使人类作者写出的作品创造力降低。注意，生成式AI影响创意写作的这两条途径未必相互排斥：它有可能在某些方面，比如新颖性，提高人类写出创意故事的能力，却没有在其他方面，比如有用性，产生同样作用。

paragraphs.en: Regardless, our study has limitations in that the creative task is constrained in its length (i.e., eight sentences), medium (i.e., writing), and type of output (i.e., short story), and there is no interactiveness with the LLM or variation in prompts. These constraints limit the generalizability and conclusions we can draw from this study.
paragraphs.zh: 不过，我们的研究存在局限，因为创作任务在篇幅（八句话）、媒介（文字写作）和作品类型（短篇故事）上都受到限制，而且参与者不能与大语言模型交互，提示词也没有变化。这些限制约束了研究结果的可推广性，也限制了我们能够从这项研究中得出的结论。

paragraphs.en: Constraining the task in such a way may constrain the extent to which participants are able to express their creativity and may not generalize to other less-constrained creativity tasks. It is possible that the effect of generative AI ideas would be attenuated for longer stories if the content of generative AI ideas does not sufficiently guide writers. Furthermore, generative AI ideas in different media, such as images or music, may be incorporated in different ways resulting in a different effect.
paragraphs.zh: 这样限制任务，可能限制参与者发挥创造力的程度；这一受限任务下的发现，也未必能推广到限制更少的其他创作任务中。如果AI提供的点子不足以持续指导作者，那么对于篇幅更长的故事，这些点子的影响可能会减弱。此外，在图像或音乐等不同媒介中，生成式AI的点子可能以不同方式被采用，从而产生不同效果。
